meta.title: Season bar, hazards list and region line when set
meta.requirement: AC7 — 12 months J–D, today's month marked, legend; hazards list; region only if set
precondition: One local place set to: region 'Tashkent region', season Best for Apr–Oct, Possible Mar and Nov, Closed Dec–Feb, hazards flood + road
steps: Open the place via its link and scroll to the season bar
Read the bar, the legend, the hazards and the region line
expected: The region line 'Tashkent region' is shown — UI tree + screenshot
place.season shows 12 months (place.season-1 … place.season-12), the legend Best / Possible / Closed, and place.season-today marks this month (month number = today's) — UI tree + screenshot
place.hazards lists Flood and Road (place.hazard-flood, place.hazard-road); place.season-empty and place.hazards-empty are absent — UI tree + screenshot

caption.expected: The region line 'Tashkent region' is shown
